شَدًا A remnant of strength; and a portion, or somewhat, thereof: (K:) a dial. var. of شَذًا. (TA. [See شَذَاةٌ, in art. شذو.]) A remnant, or remainder, of anything. (TA.) A small quantity or number: (TA:) and so ↓ شَدْوٌ , (M, K,) whatever it be, (M, TA,) of much or many, (M, K,) whatever the latter be. (K.) And The extremity of anything: (K:) a dial. var. of شَذًا. (TA.) ＝
-A2- Also Heat. (K.) ＝
-A3- And Mange, or scab: (K: [in the CK, الحَرْبُ is put for الجَرَبُ:]) a dial. var. of شَذًا. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
